children: said that interim phase 2 results for ARCT-810 showed the candidate reduced and/or maintained first morning fasting ammonia within the normal range in patients with ornithine transcarbamylase (OTC) deficiency.
The candidate also reduced glutamine, with some individuals achieving a normal range.

The company added that based on the results and a meeting with the US FDA in June, it aims to begin dosing of ARCT-2601 close to the end of the year in participants 12 years and older with the condition under an amended phase 2 protocol that integrates ARCT-2601 into the current ARCT-810 phase 2 study.

While both ARCT-810 and ARCT-2601 are mRNA therapeutics for OTC deficiency, the former uses the LUNAR platform, while the latter uses the next-generation LUNAR 2.0 platform. Arcturus says that the newer platform
greater than 30-fold higher protein expression and could allow for lower or less frequent dosing.
OTC deficiency is a rare genetic disorder in which the body stops breaking down and removing nitrogen, leading to dangerous ammonia levels in the blood.
Arcturus is also acquiring AI discovery company myNeo. The two companies have been working together since 2024. The deal is expected to close in October.

title: Arcturus sees positive results from mid-stage trial of RCT-810 in OTC deficiency
